name: Medicine Ball Push-Up
how_to:
To perform the Medicine Ball Push-Up correctly, follow these steps:

1. Place a stable medicine ball on the floor and position it under the center of your chest.
2. Grip the top of the ball with both hands close together, keeping fingers spread for control.
3. Step back into a plank with your body in a straight line, feet shoulder-width apart for balance.
4. Brace your core and glutes, keeping your spine neutral.
5. Lower your body slowly by bending the elbows close to your ribs. Aim to bring your chest close to the ball.
6. Push back up with control, extending the elbows fully while maintaining tension throughout your body.
